record.question: Small Scale Industry is one which has fixed investment in plant and machinery
options: not exceeding 1 Crore rupees and number of worker less than 50, but it uses electricity
not exceeding 2 Crore rupees and number of worker less than 50, but it uses electricity
not exceeding 3 Crore rupees and number of worker less than 20, but it uses electricity
not exceeding 1 Crore rupees and number of worker less than 25, which does not use electricity
record.explanation: The small-scale industry definition in the classic textbook form uses a fixed investment ceiling of Rs 1 crore in plant and machinery, with fewer than 50 workers when power is used. Option (d) reverses the power condition and uses a worker count of 25, so it does not match this form.
